positions.commentary: Netflix successfully transitioned its business despite landing ugly, and they are right to separate DVD and streaming.
Amazon is described as an incredible company that has done amazing amounts of innovation, arguably more than Netflix.
Google's approach to innovation is described as very super courageous but top-down, and they learned that putting hundreds of people on big ideas matters more than part-time innovation.

thesis: This episode argues that successful companies like Amazon and Netflix have demonstrated the ability to reinvent themselves through significant innovation, with Netflix specifically noted for its successful transition despite an 'ugly' landing. In contrast, Google's approach is characterized as top-down and courageous, though the speakers suggest that dedicating hundreds of people to big ideas yields better results than part-time innovation efforts.
